item.title: Mike Zambidis to face Floyd Mayweather in Athens exhibition
item.description: Veteran Greek kickboxer Mike Zambidis will take on Floyd Mayweather in an exhibition bout this June in Athens, ahead of Mayweather’s September rematch with Manny Pacquiao in Las Vegas. Zambidis, 45, holds a 157-24 kickboxing record with 87 knockouts, and last fought officially in June 2015.
